summary: Facepalm: No candidates submitted. I ran out of search budget before finding any facepalm story with two qualifying sources. The leads I did find failed on source count, on a victim, or on fit. Genius: One candidate: Voyager 1 reaching one light-day from Earth on Nov. 18. I did not find a second candidate with a complete pair of accepted sources. No facepalm story met the standard; nothing published. The verified genius story is on the bench for a later day.

candidates.headline: Voyager 1 becomes the first human-made object to reach one light-day from Earth, NASA says
candidates.reason: passed every check; kept for a later day because the other side had no story

candidates.headline: California Insurance Department accidentally reveals another judge's misconduct complaint in a court filing
candidates.reason: Only CalMatters is an accepted source, and the second-source search turned up only non-accepted blogs. The story sits inside a larger legal dispute, so it isn't a clean 'wait, what?' act.

candidates.headline: Jackson, Miss., council censures Councilman Kenneth Stokes after a profane outburst
candidates.reason: A speech and conduct dispute, not a baffling act. Mississippi Today is not on the accepted list, and the other coverage was WLBT, WAPT and Yahoo.

candidates.headline: Florida man arrested for allegedly mailing a peanut-butter-smeared letter to a woman with a severe allergy
candidates.reason: The act is a crime with a victim.

candidates.headline: Ormond Beach woman arrested after taking items and calling it a 'hide and seek' game
candidates.reason: A theft with a victim. Only a local outlet that is not on the accepted list was found.

candidates.headline: Spider monkey in a diaper found loose in Albert Lea, Minn.
candidates.reason: An animal story with no baffling human act, and UPI was the only source.

candidates.headline: Mall of America plans a Black Friday shopping-bag world record attempt
candidates.reason: A deliberate promotional record, and the event is still in the future.

candidates.headline: Webb data show first-of-its-kind stellar merger in Andromeda (Nature, Nov. 18)
candidates.reason: Lead author is at Liverpool John Moores University in the UK and the event is in Andromeda. It is not clearly a US achievement, and no accepted news page was opened.

candidates.headline: FDA approves Lembaz (adrabetadex) for infantile-onset Niemann-Pick disease type C
candidates.reason: Only the FDA page and trade or unlisted outlets (Fierce Pharma, RTTNews, Neurology Live) were found. No accepted news publisher turned up.
